sources.articleTitle: Watch: ‘Illegal’ tin shed removed at TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee's Kalighat residence
Bulldozer reaches outside Abhishek Banerjee’s house: Tin shade, boundary gate removed

headline: Municipal Authorities Remove Temporary Structure At Banerjee Residence
seoTitle: Structure Removed At Abhishek Banerjee's Home
metaDescription: Municipal authorities in Kolkata removed a tin shed from outside the residence of MP Abhishek Banerjee following a recent political confrontation.
aiSummaryBullets: Kolkata municipal workers dismantled a tin shed and boundary gate located outside the home of MP Abhishek Banerjee.
The action followed a recent altercation between the Trinamool Congress politician and individuals he identified as BJP supporters.
Banerjee has expressed concerns regarding ongoing police surveillance and potential future security threats.
aiContextParagraph: On November 12, 2026, municipal authorities in Kolkata executed the removal of a temporary tin shed and a boundary gate situated at the residence of Diamond Harbour Member of Parliament Abhishek Banerjee. This operation followed an order issued by the local police force. Tensions in the area have remained elevated since November 7, when a clash occurred outside the property. Abhishek Banerjee has publicly alleged that he was targeted by individuals associated with the Bharatiya Janata Party during an event marking his birthday. Beyond the recent physical confrontation, the MP has raised formal concerns regarding the level of police presence and surveillance near his private home. While local officials cite the removal as part of addressing an illegal structure, Banerjee has expressed apprehension about his personal security, citing fears of future incidents occurring near his residence.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to the high-profile nature of the politician involved and the direct link to recent political tensions in Kolkata.
